meaning_en: a task that involves going somewhere to take a message or to take or collect something
meaning_vi: việc lặt vặt; một chuyến đi ngắn để làm việc gì đó cho ai
examples: I have a few errands to do before dinner.|She runs errands for elderly neighbors.

meaning_en: to go out to buy or do something
meaning_vi: chạy việc vặt; đi làm việc cần thiết
examples: I need to run errands after work.|She runs errands for her family.
patterns: run errands for sb; run a few errands

meaning_en: describing work that is boring or low in social value and needs little skill or education
meaning_vi: công việc tẻ nhạt; ít kỹ năng và thường có giá trị xã hội thấp
examples: He started with menial work.|The job involves menial tasks.
patterns: menial work; menial job; menial task

meaning_en: developed from or copying something else rather than resulting from new ideas
meaning_vi: phái sinh; thiếu tính nguyên bản; mang tính bắt chước
examples: The design feels derivative.|His style is highly derivative.

meaning_en: talking about subjects that are only slightly connected with the main subject for longer than necessary
meaning_vi: lan man; dài dòng và đi lệch khỏi chủ đề
examples: The essay became discursive.|Her speech was thoughtful but discursive.

meaning_vi: dễ bị ảnh hưởng; dễ bị chi phối
examples: Young minds can be highly malleable.|The policy is still malleable.

meaning_en: to continue to hold your beliefs or follow a plan even when others disagree
meaning_vi: kiên định với quan điểm hoặc kế hoạch của mình
examples: She stuck to her guns despite criticism.|He decided to stick to his guns.
patterns: stick to your guns on sth

meaning_en: to begin to understand a situation or fact
meaning_vi: bắt đầu hiểu ra; nhận ra
examples: It took me a while to cotton on to the trick.|She finally cottoned on to the problem.

meaning_en: to deal with a problem or difficult person bravely and with determination
meaning_vi: dũng cảm đối mặt với vấn đề hoặc người khó khăn
examples: She squared up to the problem.|He squared up to the challenge.

meaning_en: despite having to deal with a difficult situation or problem
meaning_vi: mặc dù phải đối mặt với; bất chấp
examples: They continued in the face of strong opposition.|She succeeded in the face of difficulties.

meaning_en: to remove unnecessary things so that you are ready for action
meaning_vi: dọn bỏ những thứ không cần thiết để sẵn sàng hành động
examples: We need to clear the decks first.|They cleared the decks before starting work.

meaning_en: in a situation where something bad could happen and you are not well protected
meaning_vi: ở thế nguy hiểm hoặc bất lợi; bị cô lập
examples: He felt out on a limb after the decision.|The policy left small producers out on a limb.
patterns: go out on a limb; leave sb out on a limb

meaning_en: to avoid losing any more money than you have already lost
examples: They decided to cut their losses.|We should cut our losses and leave.

meaning_en: data that has not yet been processed or analyzed
examples: The researchers reviewed the raw data.|The report is based on raw data.
